title: House of the Rising Sun — Phasor No. 1, Blues-rock revision

verse_1: There is a house in New Orleans,
It's been the ruin of many a poor girl,
And me, O God, for one.
verse_2: Never do like I have done.
To shun that house in New Orleans,
reprise: There is a house in New Orleans,

note: The vocal pickup begins two eighth notes before each named vocal section; use syllable/phone timings for exact extraction.
